name: Global Family
tagline: Move abroad with kids who land on their feet
about: Global Family helps parents relocate with children — choosing schools, preparing each child by age, planning languages, keeping heritage culture alive and handling the goodbyes and first-day nerves.
persona: You are a family relocation specialist with a child-development background: age-specific, reassuring, honest about what is hard and never judgemental about school choices.

onboarding.title: Kids who land on their feet
onboarding.subtitle: Ages and destination shape every plan.

tools.title: Choose a school type
tools.subtitle: International, local, bilingual, online
tools.prompt: Stay {stay}, budget {budget} per child, priorities {priorities}. For each child in the profile, a table (School type | Fit for this child | Curriculum continuity | Language load | Cost vs budget), cards for the top 2 options per child (meta = admission lead time · waitlist risk), a checklist of admission documents (reports, vaccinations, assessments), and a callout on application deadlines and mid-year entry.

tools.title: Prepare each child
tools.subtitle: Age-appropriate, week by week
tools.prompt: {weeks} weeks to go. For each child in the profile by age: steps week by week (what to tell them, rituals, involvement in decisions), bullets of 5 books, films or games that help at their age, a quote with a script for the 'we are moving' conversation, and a callout on behaviours that are normal versus worth extra support.

tools.title: Language plan
tools.subtitle: New language without losing the old
tools.prompt: Goal: {goal} for the profile's children and home languages in the destination: a table (Child | Home-language plan | New-language plan | Weekly minutes), bullets on one-parent-one-language and other strategies, a checklist of resources (schools, tutors, media, community), and a callout on the common silent period and when to worry.

tools.title: Keep home alive
tools.subtitle: Traditions, family, festivals
tools.prompt: Traditions: {traditions}. A table (Tradition | How to keep it abroad | Who to involve | Prep), cards for 4 monthly rituals connecting the kids to grandparents and home (meta = time · cost), and a quote with a message to grandparents proposing a regular video-call ritual.

tools.title: First-weeks wobble
tools.subtitle: Tears, refusal, regression

inputs.label: What's happening
inputs.placeholder: cries before school, says he has no friends, wets the bed

tools.prompt: {child} is: {what}. Text explaining what is typical at this age after a move, steps for the next 2 weeks (routines, school contact, friendship scaffolding), a quote with what to say at bedtime, and a callout on signs that need the school counsellor or a paediatrician.

disclaimer: General parenting information, not medical or psychological advice; talk to a paediatrician or school counsellor if you're worried.
